description: This file defines the QuickSearchDefaults class, which provides default configurations and methods for setting up quicksearch functionality in SuiteCRM. It includes methods for generating search parameter arrays for various modules, loading related objects, and including necessary scripts.

classes.name: QuickSearchDefaults
classes.description: Provides default configurations and methods for quicksearch setup, including generating search parameter arrays for modules like Accounts, Contacts, Users, and Campaigns.

methods.name: getQuickSearchDefaults
methods.description: Static method to instantiate a custom or default QuickSearchDefaults object based on lookup array.

methods.name: setFormName
methods.description: Sets the form name used in quicksearch forms.

methods.name: getQSParent
methods.description: Returns quicksearch parameters for the parent module, defaulting to Accounts.

methods.name: getQSAccount
methods.description: Returns quicksearch parameters for the Accounts module with optional address fields.

methods.name: getQSContact
methods.description: Returns quicksearch parameters for the Contacts module, including locale-aware formatting.

methods.name: getQSUser
methods.description: Returns quicksearch parameters for the Users module.

methods.name: getQSCampaigns
methods.description: Returns quicksearch parameters for the Campaigns module.

methods.name: loadQSObject
methods.description: Loads quicksearch configuration for related objects based on module, object, and relationship.

methods.name: getQSScripts
methods.description: Includes JavaScript for quicksearch, compatible with SugarCRM 4.5.x.

methods.name: getQSScriptsNoServer
methods.description: Returns the same scripts as getQSScripts, for use without server-side processing.

methods.name: getQSScriptsJSONAlreadyDefined
methods.description: Includes JavaScript scripts for quicksearch, assuming they are already defined.
